transfer.stem: Which report matches the walking guide?
transfer.passage:
Our illustrated walking guide
Our class made a walking guide for a visitor. At the woodland fork, a red ribbon marked the correct path. We drew both branches and checked the ribbon colour before choosing a route. On the next page, a blue line ran from the river surface down to the bed. It showed the depth, not the distance across the river.
The guide then led visitors through a green door into the garden. Yellow flowers opened in bright sunlight beside a white wall. In the afternoon, the wall reflected the light onto the garden table. We wrote the heading in black ink so it was easy to read.
For the final picture, we drew dry leaves that had turned brown. Above them, a grey cloud hid the mountain top. The mountain was still there, although its top could not be seen through the cloud.

options.text: The red ribbon marked the correct route; the blue line showed river depth; the grey cloud blocked the view of the mountain top.
The blue ribbon marked the correct route; the blue line showed river depth; the grey cloud blocked the view of the mountain top.
The red ribbon marked the correct route; the blue line showed river width; the grey cloud blocked the view of the mountain top.
The red ribbon marked the correct route; the blue line showed river depth; the whole mountain had disappeared permanently.

answer.display: The red ribbon marked the correct route; the blue line showed river depth; the grey cloud blocked the view of the mountain top.
